scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "dist-tests/tests/**/*.test.js"
scripts.carga:k6:smoke: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f carga/docker-compose.k6.yml run --rm -e K6_MODO=smoke k6 run --summary-export=/resultados/k6-smoke.json /scripts/stress-combinado.js
scripts.carga:k6: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f carga/docker-compose.k6.yml run --rm -e K6_MODO=stress k6 run --summary-export=/resultados/k6-resumen.json /scripts/stress-combinado.js
scripts.carga:k6:100: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f carga/docker-compose.k6.yml --profile grafana up -d --wait && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f carga/docker-compose.k6.yml run --rm -e K6_MODO=stress k6 run -o experimental-prometheus-rw --summary-export=/resultados/k6-100-usuarios.json /scripts/carga-100-usuarios.js
scripts.carga:grafana:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f carga/docker-compose.k6.yml --profile grafana up -d --wait
scripts.carga:grafana:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f carga/docker-compose.k6.yml --profile grafana stop prometheus grafana && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d --force-recreate nginx ms-tarifas
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --test dist-tests/tests/e2e/e2e.test.js
